item.title: Rhino Tool House Has Acquired Teknikor
item.description: CONCORD, NC—Rhino Tool House has acquired Teknikor, an industrial services company based in Fall River, MA.

item.title: Samsung Electronics to Adopt AI-Driven Factories
item.description: SEOUL—Samsung Electronics plans to transition all manufacturing operations into AI-driven factories by 2030.

item.title: AGIBOT Launches New Humanoid Robots, Partners with Minth to Advance Robotics Training
item.description: Munich — AGIBOT, the company ranked No. 1 globally in humanoid robot shipments, unveiled its full robot portfolio, signaling its strategic expansion into the German and European markets. The launch highlighted AGIBOT’s advanced R&D, system-level robotics capabilities and the critical role of real-world training in scaling industrial deployment.

item.title: Human-Robot Collaboration Enables Companies to Create Value
item.description: BINGHAMTON, NY—New research indicates that human-robot collaboration can improve work environments.

item.title: Trisha Epp on Opening NASA-Tested Innovation to Manufacturers — Paying for Outcomes, Not Proposals
item.description: Trisha Epp, Director of Innovation at Freelancer, explains how a NASA-tested, crowdsourced approach to solving technical challenges is now available to manufacturers.

item.title: New Fastening Tools Are Precise, Flexible
item.description: From automated screw feeding systems to configurable torque wrenches, this month’s “New and Noteworthy” reflects the continued evolution of fastening technology.

item.title: EU Motors Launches U.S. Drone Motor Facility to Meet FCC Mandate
item.description: HALLANDALE BEACH, Fla. — EU Motors Sp. z o.o., one of the largest producers of drone motors outside China, has opened a new manufacturing facility in Hallandale Beach, Florida, in response to a federal mandate requiring U.S. drone manufacturers to use domestically produced electric motors.

item.title: From Volume to Value: The Auto Industry’s High-Stakes Investment Shift
item.description: GREENVILLE, S.C. – Auto industry investment is shifting to fewer, larger projects that carry significantly greater capital exposure and financial risk, according to a new report.

item.title: Ford Explorer Travels From Chicago to the Vatican
item.description: CHICAGO—Ford Motor Co.’s historic Chicago Assembly Plant recently built a one-of-a-kind Explorer for Pope Leo XIV, who grew up just a few miles from the factory.

item.title: Hanjung America to Build Energy Storage Manufacturing Facility in Indiana
item.description: HUNTINGTON, Ind. — Hanjung America Corp. plans to build its first U.S. manufacturing facility at the Riverfork West Industrial Park in Huntington, Indiana, establishing a production site for energy storage system components that will support electric vehicle battery manufacturing.
